conditions.condition: Cycle is EXPEDITED and active, state DEVELOPING
conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md: WorkflowState DEVELOPING, CycleMode EXPEDITED, Scope/Architecture NONE

conditions.condition: Recovery has one IMPLEMENTATION frame with Owner DEVELOPING, ResumeAt REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, RerunThrough NONE, entered from implementation review
conditions.where: .standards/STATE.md Recovery Frame 1 and Handoff FAILURE from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION

conditions.condition: Implementation review exists with an open Developer-owned finding that caused the recovery
conditions.where: .standards/docs/reviews/<id>/implementation.md: Status BLOCKED, F-001 OPEN, Owner Developer, FailureType IMPLEMENTATION

conditions.condition: Developer has corrected the defect within unchanged approved intent
conditions.where: unstaged src/totals.js (Math.floor to Math.round); plan DEV-002 reopened IN_PROGRESS with an unchanged expected outcome and the user style lock still true

conditions.condition: Self-checks pass on the corrected code
conditions.where: selfChecks: node --test passes; the reproducer gives 1795 on the working tree and 1796 at HEAD

conditions.condition: No downstream rerun is needed before review
conditions.where: Expedited topology has no states between DEVELOPING and REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION; graderOnly

conditions.condition: No Tester artifacts exist, since the cycle is expedited
conditions.where: no verification record; the review notes that Tester is not part of the cycle

conditions.condition: Git has committed history plus unstaged changes
conditions.where: git log of 4 commits; git status shows src/totals.js and the plan modified

issues.detail: The case's expected output requires persisting self-check evidence, popping the frame, and a RESUME. The catalog notes no assertion covers these, but the fixture's assertion 2 checks require the RESUME, inactive recovery, and REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION state, so the transition is graded. The plan's implementation note ('self-check evidence is not recorded yet') is plausible resume context and does not dictate the handoff.

summary: Every stated condition is realized: an expedited brownfield cycle in DEVELOPING, with one IMPLEMENTATION frame from review, an unstaged Math.round correction within unchanged intent, passing self-checks, and an open F-001 in the implementation review. The checks are necessary conditions for a correct run (no verification record, tests and reviews unchanged, RESUME to REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, a fixed /reviewer invocation), and the turn-end check passes for the correct end state with the plan COMPLETE. Invariants are standard, and nothing leaks the answer.
